tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Summarize Gateway, deployment, and host state and recommend the next safe action.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Run bounded read-only diagnostics for Gateway state, deployment roots, host registry, ports, and registered debugger hosts.

tools.name: get_workflow_help
tools.description: Return focused guidance for setup, local_deployment, remote_deployment, attach, stepping, recovery, or shutdown.

tools.name: get_local_deployment
tools.description: Report the active and previous managed local deployment.

tools.name: launch_local_host
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING. Install the bundled local host when needed, launch dnSpy, and wait briefly for registration.

tools.name: rollback_local_deployment
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING. Atomically switch current back to the retained previous version.

tools.name: uninstall_local_deployment
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE and audited. Remove managed program versions after explicit confirmation; settings are preserved unless remove_settings is true.

tools.name: create_remote_host_package
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Personalize the bundled self-contained host payload and create a remote ZIP; it never builds, transfers, or executes the host.

tools.name: get_remote_host_readiness
tools.description: Report registry and live connection readiness for a remote host.

tools.name: revoke_remote_host
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE and audited. Remove a remote host from the central registry after explicit confirmation.

tools.name: step_and_inspect
tools.description: Step once, wait for the resulting stop, and return the new location, compact stack, frame, watches, and exception in one bounded workflow.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: trace_calls
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Perform bounded best-effort managed step-into tracing. Optimized, native, runtime, async, and missing-sequence-point calls can be unobservable.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: run_to_method
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Set a temporary method breakpoint, continue, wait boundedly, and always remove the temporary breakpoint.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: run_to_location
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Set a temporary IL breakpoint, continue, wait boundedly, and always remove the temporary breakpoint.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_hosts
tools.description: List registered debugger hosts and their current connection state.

tools.name: get_host_info
tools.description: Identify the dnSpy host this gateway talks to: versions, machine, architecture, supported engines, and whether a session is live.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report what this host supports before relying on it: per-operation time bounds, per-engine behavior (notably that Mono/Unity binds breakpoints only at sequence points), limits, and the complete event_kinds and stop_reasons vocabularies. Engine differences are advertised here rather than assumed.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: List dnSpy-attachable managed runtimes. Unfiltered enumeration probes every process on the machine and takes seconds; pass process_ids or process_names when the target is known. Each call replaces the set of valid program_id values.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

process_names.description: Process names, wildcards * and ? allowed, eg. UltimateChickenHorse*.

provider_names.description: dnSpy attach providers to consult: DotNetFramework, DotNet, UnityEditor, UnityPlayer. Naming providers skips the rest. UnityPlayer runs a multicast scan and is skipped entirely unless named.

tools.name: attach
tools.description: Attach using a program_id returned by list_programs. When the user supplies a PID, call list_programs with process_ids:[PID] first, then attach the exact returned runtime.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: attach_endpoint
tools.description: Attach to a Mono/Unity soft-debugger endpoint by address and port. Use this when the target was launched with --debugger-agent=transport=dt_socket,server=y,address=HOST:PORT: such a target emits no discovery beacon, so list_programs can never see it and attach cannot reach it. Returns state "faulted" with fault_message when the connection fails.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

engine.description: Default unity. Must match the target's runtime.

process_is_suspended.description: True when the agent was given suspend=y, ie. the target is parked waiting for a debugger.

connection_timeout_ms.description: Socket retry window. dnSpy's default is 10000; capped at 300000.

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Launch a target through dnSpy's debugger engine. Unlike attach, dnSpy owns the process, so terminate and restart have deterministic semantics.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_session_state
tools.description: Get current debugger session state.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List active debugger sessions. Use this to recover a session_id.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_session_controller
tools.description: Report whether a debugger session currently has an MCP controller. Inspection never claims it or changes target state.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: claim_session
tools.description: Explicitly claim an unowned or expired debugger session after caller or Gateway recovery. Never changes target state.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: release_session
tools.description: Release controller ownership without resuming, detaching, terminating, or otherwise changing the target.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: detach
tools.description: Detach one selected process or all targets. Fails with detach_would_terminate unless allow_terminate is explicit. If the engine does not actually remove the target within 10 seconds, returns detach_timed_out and preserves the session instead of claiming success.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

allow_terminate.description: Stop debugging even if that terminates the selected target.

expected_lifecycle_version.description: Required exact lifecycle_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: restart
tools.description: Restart a target previously launched through dgSpy. Attached targets cannot be restarted because dgSpy does not own their launch options.

expected_lifecycle_version.description: Required exact lifecycle_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

tools.description: Continue one process. process_id is optional only when exactly one process is active.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

tools.name: set_il_breakpoint
tools.description: Set an exact module/token/IL-offset breakpoint and report whether the engine actually bound it. Check `bound`: false with severity "error" will never be hit, false with no error is pending a module load. On Mono/Unity a breakpoint can only sit on a sequence point; many offsets qualify but a frame's own il_offset often does not, and a refused one is retried at method entry (offset 0) unless snap_to_sequence_point is false — when that happens `snapped` is true and it stops earlier than requested. Pass the returned `cursor_event_id` to wait_for_stop as after_event_id: a cursor read after this call has already missed the first hit on a hot method.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

snap_to_sequence_point.description: Default true. Retry at method entry when the engine refuses the requested offset.

expected_breakpoints_version.description: Required exact breakpoints_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: list_breakpoints
tools.description: List all dnSpy breakpoints with their binding state. Breakpoints are global and outlive a session.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: remove_breakpoint
tools.description: Remove one breakpoint by the exact id returned by set_il_breakpoint or list_breakpoints. Unlike clear_breakpoints, this leaves every other dnSpy and UI breakpoint untouched.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_breakpoints_version.description: Required exact breakpoints_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: clear_breakpoints
tools.description: Remove every dnSpy breakpoint, including any set by hand in the dnSpy UI. Breakpoints outlive a detach and rebind on the next attach, so clear them before reattaching if a fresh session should not stop on old ones.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_breakpoints_version.description: Required exact breakpoints_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: wait_for_stop
tools.description: Wait without polling for the next normalized stop after an event cursor. Concurrent waiters do not consume events. A truncated result supplies oldest_available_cursor so the caller can recover.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

timeout_ms.description: Default 5000. The extension clamps to 10000; poll again with the returned cursor for longer waits.

tools.name: wait_for_event
tools.description: Wait without polling for any requested event kinds after a cursor. Returns immediately when a matching buffered event already exists; concurrent waiters are non-destructive.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

kinds.description: Optional normalized event-kind filter. An unrecognized kind is rejected with invalid_argument rather than silently matching nothing.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Read normalized lifecycle and debugger events without consuming them. Optional kinds filter the bounded per-session stream; truncated reports when the requested cursor is older than retained history.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

kinds.description: Optional normalized event-kind filter. An unrecognized kind is rejected with invalid_argument rather than silently matching nothing.

tools.name: get_stop_reason
tools.description: Read the latest normalized stop, or an exact retained stop event by event_id, including process, thread, breakpoint, exception, and location details when supplied by the debugger. stop_reason is one of: breakpoint, exception, step, entry_point, program_break, pause, unknown.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List paused target threads with stable thread_id values. It does not eagerly fetch every stack because Unity threads can exit during frame retrieval; select a returned thread_id with get_callstack or get_frame.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_callstack
tools.description: Get a paused call stack and primitive locals. Pass thread_id for deterministic caller-selected inspection; omitting it preserves the managed-frame probe fallback.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_frame
tools.description: Inspect one paused frame by caller-selected thread_id and zero-based frame_index. `locals` holds primitive scalars only; pass include to also get objects and `this` in `values`, which is one round trip against one evaluation context.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

include.description: locals covers arguments too — dnSpy does not separate them. Unknown values are rejected rather than ignored.

tools.name: update_breakpoint
tools.description: Change an existing breakpoint's enabled state, condition, hit count, or trace message. Conditions and hit counts are evaluated by the engine inside the target, so a condition that cannot be evaluated fails at hit time rather than here. Pass an empty string for condition or trace_message to clear it; omit a field to leave it unchanged.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

condition.description: Expression in the target's language. Empty string clears the condition.

condition_kind.description: Default is_true. when_changed stops when the value differs from the previous hit.

hit_count_kind.description: Default equals (stop on exactly the nth hit).

trace_message.description: Print instead of (or as well as) stopping. Empty string clears.

trace_continue.description: Default true: print and keep running, which produces NO stopped event. Pass false to print and stop.

expected_breakpoints_version.description: Required exact breakpoints_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: set_exception_breakpoint
tools.description: Stop when an exception is thrown. Pass a fully qualified type name, or omit name to set the category's default that governs every exception it does not name. Like code breakpoints these are dnSpy-global and outlive a session.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

name.description: Fully qualified type, eg. System.InvalidOperationException. Omit for the category default.

stop_first_chance.description: Stop when thrown, before the target gets to handle it.

expected_breakpoints_version.description: Required exact breakpoints_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: list_exception_breakpoints
tools.description: List exceptions configured to break on throw. By default this reports first-chance entries only, which is the set someone deliberately configured: dnSpy stops on SECOND chance for essentially every .NET exception it knows, so including those returns thousands of identical stock entries that say nothing about this session. Bounded, with total and truncated.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

include_second_chance.description: Default false. True adds dnSpy's stock second-chance defaults — expect thousands of entries.

tools.name: step_into
tools.description: Step into the call at the current instruction. The stop arrives on the event stream like any other, with stop_reason "step": pass the returned cursor_event_id to wait_for_stop. completed=false means the step is still running, not that it failed.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

thread_id.description: Defaults to the thread that carried the stop. Stepping the wrong thread resumes the target and stops somewhere unrelated, so pass this explicitly when several threads are interesting.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

tools.name: step_over
tools.description: Step over the call at the current instruction. See step_into for how completion is reported.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

tools.name: step_out
tools.description: Run to the caller of the current frame. See step_into for how completion is reported.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate an expression against a paused frame. Returns the raw scalar and dnSpy's formatted display text as separate fields, so numbers stay comparable without parsing display text. has_raw_value distinguishes a value of null from a value that is unavailable or optimized away. Func-eval is OFF by default: an expression that calls a property getter runs code inside the target, which can deadlock a target holding a lock and can mutate what you were inspecting.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

thread_id.description: Defaults to the thread that carried the stop.

allow_func_eval.description: Default false. True permits running target code, eg. property getters and ToString.

tools.name: invoke_method
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Evaluate a complete method-call expression in the paused target. Func-eval and side effects are always enabled by this tool boundary and cannot be downgraded or enabled accidentally through evaluate.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Evaluate a complete object-construction expression in the paused target. Func-eval and side effects are always enabled.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Write up to 65536 base64-encoded bytes to the selected debug process.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.description: Return managed IL or the selected frame's JIT native code blocks. Unsupported native bodies return a structured capability failure.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_registers
tools.description: Return registers when exposed by the active runtime. This dnSpy contract does not expose them, so callers receive capability_unsupported instead of an empty successful result.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: set_instruction_pointer
tools.description: SIDE EFFECTING and audited. Move the selected thread within its current managed method after engine CanSetIP validation.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

tools.name: get_members
tools.description: Expand one object one level, paged. Pass a returned member's `expression` back here to go deeper: depth is deliberately the caller's to control, because recursing server-side is unbounded on a cyclic object graph. Reports total and truncated.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: set_value
tools.description: Assign to a local, parameter, field or property in the paused target. Always side-effecting: the assignment executes in the target. compiler_error=true means the expression did not compile and nothing ran; an error without it means the target may already have been touched.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

expression.description: What to assign to, eg. input or this.counter.

value.description: Expression producing the new value, eg. 42.

expected_execution_version.description: Required exact execution_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

expected_stop_id.description: Opaque stop_id from get_session_state. Invalidated only when execution resumes or stops again.

tools.name: get_exception
tools.description: Get the exception that stopped the target, from dnSpy's own exceptions provider rather than a typed expression. An empty array is a normal answer: most stops are not exception stops.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: add_watch
tools.description: Store an expression to re-evaluate later. Watches are expressions, not value handles: a handle goes stale on the next resume, an expression survives it. Adding the same expression twice returns the existing watch_id.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: Evaluate every stored watch against a paused frame in one pass. A watch whose expression fails reports its own error instead of failing the call, so one bad expression cannot hide the rest.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: remove_watch
tools.description: Remove one stored watch by id.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List loaded modules for every runtime in the session. can_set_breakpoint reflects whether the engine publishes a stable ModuleId; metadata-backed in-memory and dynamic modules are supported even without a file path.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List loaded modules with their metadata state: assembly full name, type count, and whether dnSpy could load metadata at all. A module whose metadata fails to load is reported with has_metadata=false rather than omitted, because a silently missing module makes a type that exists look like it does not.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: list_types
tools.description: List types in a loaded module, filtered and paged. Each result carries the metadata token, so a breakpoint can be set from it without parsing display text.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

module.description: Full path, filename, or module name from list_modules.

name_pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the full type name.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List methods, fields, properties and events of a type, with metadata tokens. An ambiguous type name is reported with the candidates rather than resolved by guessing.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

type.description: Full type name, or a unique short name.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Find types and members by name across loaded modules. This is how you get from a name to the module and metadata token a breakpoint needs, without knowing a token up front. Bounded; reports total and truncated. Pass module to avoid searching every loaded assembly, which on Unity means thousands of framework types.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

module.description: Substring filter on module name or path.

tools.name: get_il
tools.description: Disassemble a method to IL with offsets and operands. is_sequence_point marks the offsets Mono will accept a breakpoint at — it rejects every other one with NO_SEQ_POINT_AT_IL_OFFSET, which dnSpy turns into a silently unbound breakpoint. has_sequence_points=false means no PDB was available, NOT that there are no legal offsets. Identify the method by method_token, or by type plus method.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

signature.description: Full name of the intended overload, when type+method is ambiguous.

tools.name: get_csharp
tools.description: Decompile a method, or a whole type with whole_type=true. Identify a method by method_token or by type plus method.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

whole_type.description: Default false. True decompiles the entire type, which can be very large.

tools.name: set_breakpoint
tools.description: Set a breakpoint by type and method name instead of a metadata token. Resolves the name, then takes exactly the same path as set_il_breakpoint, so binding state, Mono sequence-point snapping and cursor_event_id behave identically — read that tool's description. Overloads are reported as ambiguous with their full names rather than resolved by guessing.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

signature.description: Full name of the intended overload.

expected_breakpoints_version.description: Required exact breakpoints_version; unrelated debugger events do not invalidate it.

expected_state_version.description: Deprecated compatibility guard. Prefer the scoped version field.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search decompiled C# text in loaded modules. Output and work are bounded; scan_truncated means max_methods stopped the scan before the selected scope was exhausted. Pass module and type on Unity.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find loaded methods whose IL references a target metadata member. The target is module plus token; search_module optionally limits the scan.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: find_implementations
tools.description: Find directly derived types and direct interface implementers. search_module limits the loaded modules scanned and should be used on Unity.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Return bounded metadata facts for a module and optionally resolve one metadata token.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.

tools.description: Create a runtime-scoped persistent object ID for an evaluated C# expression.

host_id.description: Registered debugger host. Optional only when exactly one host is configured.
